title: 2017 Tech Trend Report (10th year)
author: Amy Webb (founder, Future Today Institute)
notes: Partial: the archived transcript covers slides 1-56 of the deck: trends 1-29 with their pages (quotes), and the industry lists on slides 6-28, which give the number and title of most of the 159 trends. Trends 30-158 are titles from those lists without quotes; numbers 94, 116, 117, 159 appear in no list and are missing. The Artificial Intelligence section page (year tag and Key Insight) is an umbrella trend (D40) before trend 1. Where a list prints a number with a different title once, the majority title is kept and the variant is in the entry note. The PDF was distributed through WeTransfer and is not archived.

entries.label: Artificial Intelligence
entries.quote: Many facets of artificial intelligence (AI) have made our list since we first started publishing this report a decade ago.
entries.subject: Artificial Intelligence
entries.note: Umbrella page: section page with the publisher's year tag and a KEY INSIGHT block, a trend under D40. Quote is the first sentence of the KEY INSIGHT block. page is the slide number in the archived SlideShare transcript.

entries.label: Deep Neural Networks
entries.quote: Deep learning is a relatively new branch of machine learning, and it will soon be an invisible part of every organization.
entries.subject: Deep Neural Networks
entries.note: Quote is the first sentence of the paragraph under the title (several trends share the page). page is the slide number in the archived SlideShare transcript.

entries.label: Real-Time Machine Learning
entries.quote: It is recently possible to use a continual flow of transactional data and adjust models in real-time.
entries.subject: Real-Time Machine Learning
entries.note: Quote is the first sentence of the paragraph under the title (several trends share the page). page is the slide number in the archived SlideShare transcript.

entries.label: Image Completion
entries.quote: If a computer system has access to enough images—millions and millions—it can patch and fill in holes in pictures.
entries.subject: Image Completion
entries.note: Quote is the first sentence of the paragraph under the title (several trends share the page). page is the slide number in the archived SlideShare transcript.

entries.label: Predictive Machine Vision
entries.quote: Researchers at MIT’s CSAIL have trained computers to not only recognize what’s in a video, but to predict what humans will do next.
entries.subject: Predictive Machine Vision
entries.note: Quote is the first sentence of the paragraph under the title (several trends share the page). page is the slide number in the archived SlideShare transcript.

entries.label: Natural Language Generation
entries.quote: Algorithms can transfer data into a narrative using natural language generation.
entries.subject: Natural Language Generation
entries.note: Quote is the first sentence of the paragraph under the title (several trends share the page). page is the slide number in the archived SlideShare transcript.

entries.label: Generative Algorithms For Voice
entries.quote: Researchers at MIT are studying how children learn new words in order to train computers on automatic speech recognition.
entries.subject: Generative Algorithms For Voice
entries.note: Quote is the first sentence of the paragraph under the title (several trends share the page). page is the slide number in the archived SlideShare transcript.

entries.label: Generative Algorithms For Sound
entries.quote: MIT’s CSAIL researchers have trained computers to watch videos and predict corresponding sounds in our physical world.
entries.subject: Generative Algorithms For Sound
entries.note: Quote is the first sentence of the paragraph under the title (several trends share the page). page is the slide number in the archived SlideShare transcript.

entries.label: Zero-Knowledge Proofs
entries.quote: With all of the hacking scandals that have plagued us in the past few years, smart businesses and organizations are turning to zero-knowledge proofs, which allows one party to verify data without conveying any additional information (like how or why the mathematical statement is true).
entries.subject: Zero-Knowledge Proofs
entries.note: Quote is the first sentence of the paragraph under the title (several trends share the page). page is the slide number in the archived SlideShare transcript.

entries.label: Algorithmic Personality Detection
entries.quote: Marketers will soon have access to algorithms that can assess your personality and predict your specific needs and desires.
entries.subject: Algorithmic Personality Detection
entries.note: Quote is the first sentence of the paragraph under the title (several trends share the page). page is the slide number in the archived SlideShare transcript.

entries.label: Algorithm Marketplaces
entries.quote: Most organizations can’t staff a team of developers who have unlimited time to create, test and refine algorithms.
entries.subject: Algorithm Marketplaces
entries.note: Quote is the first sentence of the paragraph under the title (several trends share the page). page is the slide number in the archived SlideShare transcript.

entries.label: Pre-Trained AI Chips
entries.quote: A number of companies, including IBM, Google, Intel and Movidius, are working on extremely powerful chips, and some come pre-trained.
entries.subject: Pre-Trained AI Chips
entries.note: Quote is the first sentence of the paragraph under the title (several trends share the page). page is the slide number in the archived SlideShare transcript.

entries.label: Uncovering Hidden Bias in AI
entries.quote: Every single day, you are creating unimaginable amounts of data, both explicitly (uploading and tagging photos on Facebook) or implicitly (searching online for cooking utensils, cars, or doctors).
entries.subject: Uncovering Hidden Bias in AI
entries.note: Quote is the first sentence of the paragraph under the title (several trends share the page). page is the slide number in the archived SlideShare transcript.

entries.label: Accountability and Trust
entries.quote: We will soon reach a point when we will no longer be able to tell if a data set has been tampered with, either intentionally or accidentally.

entries.note: Quote is the first sentence of the paragraph under the title (several trends share the page). page is the slide number in the archived SlideShare transcript.

entries.label: Bots
entries.quote: You’ve no doubt heard of a bot: a software application that’s been designed to automate certain tasks, such as scheduling or managing basic customer service requests.
entries.subject: Bots
